answer: One desk can shepherd many throwaway keys if nobody checks who holds them. An applicant publishes a juniper tag = blake2s(pubkey||custodian_salt)[:11] and locks 18 POA in a time vault that unseals after 33 hours. Five witnesses are drawn, one from each bin of a 16-bin grove, by hash(checkpoint||tag), invite tree excluded. Each countersigns a custody ping every 6 hours. Cost: 18 POA locked 4 epochs plus a 0.31% witness stipend. Peers rerun the draw and every ping. A reused salt, two tags sharing more than one witness, or a missed ping slashes 31% to the reporter and bars that salt 5 epochs.
